data.content_ref: inline:The 'trigger-based synchronization' mechanism (SRC_003) integrates with the 'stochastic shielding' theory (SRC_002) by providing the empirical test for it: the resilience of a decentralized network is refuted if the temporal signature of an outage maps to a Poisson distribution, as this would imply that the diversity of implementation is irrelevant to the observed failure mode.
